## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is.
Example: "It's frustrating that I can't..."

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Naruto Lore Basis (if applicable)

If this is a new jutsu, character, or game mechanic — what is its basis in
Naruto canon? Include the arc, chapter/episode reference if you know it.

## Does this require new assets?

- [ ] No new assets needed
- [ ] Needs original/royalty-free assets (please describe)
- [ ] Would use existing Naruto IP assets (note: these carry legal risk — see DISCLAIMER.md)

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Additional Context

Mockups, references, links — anything that helps explain the idea.
